links.outcome: Accuracy and ambiguity of ChatGPT-4 deprescribing outputs versus HCP judgement
links.effect: 22.1% ambiguous outputs, generic answers and inaccuracies; overall agreement 95% but κ = .200; criteria agreement 74.7% to 91.3%, with low kappas.
links.quote: Important limitations of GPT-4 responses were identified, including 22.1% ambiguous outputs, generic answers and inaccuracies, posing inappropriate decision-making risks.

screen.reason: Evaluated ChatGPT-4's deprescribing recommendations compared to healthcare providers using retrospective patient data, without testing a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
